description: Delete a Metrika counter. IRREVERSIBLE: the counter and all its collected statistics are lost permanently. Requires `confirm: true` — without it the tool refuses and calls nothing. Also requires an OAuth token with the `metrika:write` scope; a read-only token fails with 403. Use when the user has explicitly asked to delete one Metrika counter and accepts that its statistics are lost. Do not use it to create a site; call create-counter. Do not use it to inspect a counter; call get-counter.

confirm.description: Must be exactly true to actually delete. Omit it (or pass false) and the tool refuses without calling the Metrika API.

name: delete-counter
